The apparent university setting is misdirection: "courses" are not academic classes but the courses of a meal. In one evening, the narrator attended a multi-course dinner as a guest. The narrator did not like the food, so left each course uneaten. The servers cleared the plates away between courses as normal service, so by the end of the evening every course was gone. Thus "all my courses were gone in one evening" means all the dinner courses were removed and never eaten by the narrator.
